phrases.text: This is a full tour of every named place on the Fortnite map right now, straight from Epic's official map data.
Forty points on the map: thirteen big named locations, twenty landmarks, and seven Override Consoles.
We'll go clockwise from the north. Save this one for your next drop.
Part one: the thirteen named locations.
First up, Freaky Fields, in the north of the island.
Next, WonkeeLand, in the north-east of the island.
Reality's Reign sits near the centre of the island.
After that, Golden Grove, in the east of the island.
Then Shaken Sanctuary, in the south-east of the island.
Keep going and you hit Cluster Coast, on the far south-east edge of the island.
Sunken Shores sits on the far south edge of the island.
After that, Stone Sanctum, in the south-west of the island.
Then Heatwave Harbor, on the far south-west edge of the island.
Keep going and you hit Green Hill Zone, in the west of the island.
Epic's Override news says the island now has areas inspired by gaming legends like Sonic, Tetris, and Pac-Man.
Chopped Shop sits on the far north-west edge of the island.
After that, Nightmare Neighborhood, in the north-west of the island.
Then Lifty Lodge, on the far north-west edge of the island.
Quick break: if you're buying anything today, use code BAD in the Item Shop. It really helps the channel and keeps these videos coming.
Part two: the landmarks. These are the smaller spots, and some of them are worth knowing.
Stack o' Stones is in the north of the island.
There's a Carwash in the south-east of the island,
Pinky Island, on the far south-east edge of the island.
Next, Pixel Polys, in the south of the island.
Crashout Estates is on the far south edge of the island.
Then there's Wettest-Bones Research Facility, in the south of the island.
Mega Maze, in the south of the island.
Next, Blinky Island, on the far south-west edge of the island.
The Quackaway is on the far south-west edge of the island.
Then there's Birder's Beach, on the far south-west edge of the island.
Dark Cartridge, near the centre of the island.
Epic says a cursed cartridge is spreading through the Island, corrupting everything it touches.
Next, Barncade, in the south-west of the island.
Dine 'n Docks is on the far west edge of the island.
Then there's Geno's Machine, near the centre of the island.
and yes, a second Carwash, on the far west edge of the island.
Next, Artsy RVs, on the far west edge of the island.
Ol' Stumpy is in the north-west of the island.
Then there's Pac-Man Island, in the north of the island.
Freddy Fazbear's Pizzeria, in the north of the island.
Epic says one animatronic boss is always lurking at Freddy Fazbear's Pizza Parlor.
Next, The Sleazy Snooze, on the far north edge of the island.
And finally, part three: the seven Override Consoles.
Console one, in the north of the island.
Console two, in the north-east of the island.
Console three, in the south-east of the island.
Console four, in the south of the island.
Console five, in the south-west of the island.
Console six, in the west of the island.
Console seven, in the north-west of the island.
That's every named place on the map right now.
Where are you dropping first? Tell me in the comments.
And if this helped, use code BAD in the Item Shop. See you in the next one.
